title.narrative: FOKUS Building gender inclusive recovery with Ukraine’s women’s movement

description.narrative:
Women and girls constitute the majority of the 14.6 million in need of humanitarian assistance and the vast majority of returnees, experience higher rates of poverty, unemployment and internal displacement than men and multiple forms of gender-based violence (GBV), including conflict-related sexual violence (CRSV) and trafficking in human beings (THB). Women’s rights organisations (WROs) have been on the forefront of the humanitarian response throughout Ukraine but have nonetheless been neglected in support efforts and insufficiently included in recovery processes, severely limiting local WROs capacities to build a democratic and gender equal post-conflict Ukraine and protect women’s and girls’ rights. To respond to these crises, a consortium consisting of Forum for Women and Development (FOKUS), Ukrainian Women’s Fund (UWF) and Civil Society Organisation La Strada Ukraine (LSU), proposes the project:
The project’s aim is to enhance the capacity of the Ukrainian women’s movement to engage in inclusive and sustainable recovery, deepen democratic governance and protect and promote women’s and girls’ rights during full-scale war. It will initially operate in 12 of Ukraine’s 24 oblasts, with a particular focus on building the capacity of organisations championing gender equality in hromadas (municipalities).
To achieve this aim, the project will implement the following activities: Capacity enhancement trainings of WROs: Through establishing regional capacity building hubs the project will train local WROs in among other things organisational management, coalition building, advocacy and gender transformational recovery. There will be thematic trainings on GBV, THB and enhancing social cohesion, and organisations will receive mentoring and support.
